title: Nairobi Sentinel-1 IW GRD catalogue inventory
interpretation_limits: The AOI is a rectangular discovery and exercise boundary, not an official Nairobi administrative boundary.
Footprint coverage does not certify radiometric quality or scientific suitability.
Online status and catalogue download links do not prove authorized product download; Copernicus product downloads require an access token.
The four full-AOI candidates are slice products, each identified as slice 4 of 11.
